name: Hugging Face PEFT
description: Parameter-efficient adapter library (LoRA and variants, IA3, OFT, prompt tuning and others), used by trainers rather than a trainer itself. Saves adapter_model.safetensors by default; merge_and_unload() produces merged weights.

provenance.notes: Release v0.21.2 published 2026-10-01. Source checked on the access date; not independently reproduced.
